abstract: Severe hypoxia is cytotoxic to the brain of most vertebrates. It was previously believed that only highly specialized species are adapted to this stress, but a new study demonstrates astounding tissue-level tolerance to hypoxia in the chicken brain, an otherwise hypoxia-intolerant animal.
